development_seed_derivation: For partition p and stream s: first16bytes SHA256(UTF8("mobile_money_aml_synthetic_100k_v4|2026092915|"+p+"|"+s)), interpreted little-endian unsigned128. Feed explicitly version-pinned NumPy PCG64DXSM Generator; each unit gets stream suffix /unit/<index>.
holdout_seed_derivation: After authorization custodian samples a fresh256-bit secret salt, commits SHA256(salt), and derives holdout seeds by HMAC-SHA256(salt, UTF8(dataset_id|partition|stream|unit)); first16bytes little-endian. Salt stays sealed until experiment retirement. Public design master seed never permits developers to regenerate holdouts.
